# FlexiRule Documentation

> Enterprise documentation for FlexiRule, a metadata-driven automation and rules orchestration platform for Frappe teams.

Application repository: https://github.com/Sendipad/flexirule
Documentation repository: https://github.com/Sendipad/flexirule-docs
